note: Generic registry for the white-label law-firm portal. Firms may add their own forums. 'verified' = confirmed from official notices/manuals on 14.11.2026; 'to_verify' = not yet checked.

credential_policy.reason: Login needs captcha and OTP; filing needs the advocate's own DSC/Aadhaar e-Sign; payment OTP is personal. Unattended login and filing is not possible.
flow: Advocate logs in on own Chrome (captcha + OTP typed by advocate)
Portal/Claude takes over the live session: selects case type, fills forms, prepares PDFs to the forum's limit, uploads
Portal pauses for DSC/e-Sign, fee payment and final submit - done by the advocate

automation_levels.A: Assisted filing: prefill forms and upload prepared PDFs; advocate does login, signing, payment, final submit
automation_levels.B: Online complaint form: prefill and upload; advocate does login/OTP and submit
automation_levels.C: No online filing found: prepare PDFs and filing checklist only

forums.name: Calcutta High Court (incl. Circuit Bench, Jalpaiguri)
forums.login: Registered mobile / email / Bar Registration Number + password; captcha
forums.format: PDF; A4; TNR 14; 1.5 spacing; margins T/B 1.5in, L 1.75in, R 1in
forums.notes: e-Filing 3.0. Advocate must add practice locations. Files above the limit: use designated centres or split.

forums.name: WB District and Sub-Divisional Courts (incl. City Civil Court, Alipore, Commercial Courts)
forums.format: As per Calcutta HC e-filing rules
forums.notes: e-Filing 3.0 inaugurated in all WB district/sub-divisional courts on 01.10.2024; began as a pilot for a few petition types - check each case type before relying on it.

forums.name: Debts Recovery Tribunals, Kolkata, and DRAT
forums.login: Login External: mobile number + password + captcha
forums.format: PDF, max 5 MB for each type of document
forums.notes: E-filing mandatory since 23.06.2025. Draft stays saved for 15 days. Diary number generated at the end.

forums.name: NCLT, Kolkata Bench
forums.login: Username + password + captcha; advocate must be in the representative dropdown
forums.notes: Separate flows for Companies Act and IBC. File-size limit not confirmed. Known portal outages and an advocate-dropdown mapping glitch reported.

forums.name: NCLAT (appeals from NCLT Kolkata)
forums.format: Single bookmarked PDF containing all documents; split if above 50 MB
forums.notes: Check current rule on hard copies alongside e-filing receipt.

forums.name: GST Appellate Tribunal, Kolkata Bench (Alipore)
forums.signing: DSC or Aadhaar e-Sign for final submission
forums.format: Offline Excel utility + documents; appeal on Form GST APL-05
forums.notes: Kolkata bench operational from 23.03.2026. Helpline 1800-103-4782 and incident form on portal.

forums.name: WB Consumer Commissions (District and State)
forums.payment: Fee online; appeal deposits before State Commission by demand draft
forums.notes: e-Daakhil launched in WB on 24.12.2021; an e-Jagriti portal also exists - confirm which one WB commissions use now.

forums.name: West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority (WBRERA)
forums.notes: Complaints through the website. WBHIRA is not to be used (held unconstitutional).

forums.name: West Bengal Administrative Tribunal
forums.notes: Website found; no e-filing facility found.
